newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Hurricane kills at least 10 in Central America.
newsitem.headline: Hurricane kills at least 10 in Central America.

text.p: At least 10 people were killed and hundreds were driven from their homes when torrential rain from Hurricane Lili lashed Central America, rescue workers and local authorities said on Thursday.
The highest death toll was in Nicaragua, where Civil Defence officials said five people had drowned in swollen rivers in different parts of the country over the past four days.
In neighboring Costa Rica, officials said four people had died and the country's coffee crop had likely suffered damage.
In Honduras, officials said a boy was killed when his house in a Tegucigalpa shantytown collapsed. About 300 people had been made homeless, they added.
Lili appeared to have largely spared Guatemala and Panama, where heavy rains but no deaths were reported.
On Thursday the hurricane, which began early in the week as a depression, was headed for Cuba. It brushed Mexico's Yucatan coast Wednesday but no serious damage or injuries were reported there.
